description: Source marker [1] inside the text; pointing, focusing or tapping shows the title, the excerpt and the link.

howToUse: Place it right after the sentence it supports, numbered in the order the sources appear.
Put the excerpt that backs the sentence in `snippet`, so the person checks it without leaving the page.
Repeat the same number when the same source supports another sentence.
alternatives: A full preview of a page: LinkCard.
An explanation of a term: Tooltip or HoverCard.

keyboard.action: Focuses the marker and opens the source.
